module: rs.core.shards.psm1 — New-ShardPlan(-Entries -Layout [-Grouping] [-GroupSort] [-OrderStrict] [-PackObjective] [-ShardQuotaBytes] [-ShardToleranceBytes] [-MaxFilesPerShard] [-ShardStem]) → plan. Pure planning: zero I/O, zero offsets. Internally: enumerate → measure (Measure-Row from container) → classify → strict baseline (shape-exact: FrontLoad greedy+adjacent-merge, Even linear-partition) → flexible rearrangement (FFD + tolerance-bounded bin elimination + shape pass) → sequence → plan; the packer core is a pure function over a size vector (synthetic-vector tests). FILED, NOT STARTED (shards-brief, revised 2026-08-18).
$comment: Export phase 1. Decides membership, arrangement, and global indexing; serialize consumes the plan; nothing flows back. Entries are held as REFERENCES into assemble.out.result.Entries (indices or the objects themselves) — the plan never copies content and never embeds the IR or the layout (no god object; admiral holds those). Header schema / widths / bytes come from container.out.layout, resolved before this stage. Grouping ByFileType derives the extension from RelativePath (Extension is excluded from entry bags by assemble). Row bytes are exact and packing-invariant (fixed-width gidx). Ledger #40–#48.

Grouping.note: containment unit; Flat = one group. A shard never mixes groups; packing runs per group. Default Flat

GroupSort.note: per-group nominal order; PathAsc = RelativePath ordinal ascending (default); PathHash = Get-PathHash (numerics, ledger #4) as a reading-order device

OrderStrict.note: $true: shards are contiguous runs of nominal order (greedy contiguous, optimal at quota; + tolerance → shape-exact, ledger #48). $false (default): membership optimized within group, nominal sort restored within each shard for rendering

PackObjective.note: clause 2 of §Objective — the shape of the sub-shard remainder at the settled ShardCount, never a shard-count lever (ledger #48). FrontLoad (default, working): fill to quota in nominal order, remainder as the group's tail. Even: spread the remainder, minimize the largest shard then the next. No preset/profile layer over the knobs — quota + tolerance semantics are the whole surface

ShardQuotaBytes.note: target — a Size (whole written file: header + rows). Packing capacity. Working default 32768

ShardToleranceBytes.note: exact bytes above quota a PACKED shard may reach only when that eliminates a shard; ceiling = quota + tolerance. Working default 4096

MaxFilesPerShard.note: second capacity dimension honored alongside bytes. Default 100000

ShardStem.note: filename stem for Key derivation (from RunContext/Root)

Entries.note: canonical ingested order in; every entry becomes exactly one record (atomicity — never split; ledger #47)

RelativePath.note: grouping key source (root dir / extension) and GroupSort key; idxmap key

Content.note: measured via Measure-Row(layout, entry) — never rendered here; the codec's byte count is a counting fold

HeaderBytes.note: seeds every shard's PlannedSizeBytes; capacity = quota − HeaderBytes

IdxWidth.note: gidx width; assigned values come after packing, width is known before

Columns.note: what Measure-Row measures per entry (sources, widths); shards passes it through, does not interpret it

Shards.note: in final reading order (Ordinal ascending) — groups concatenated, bins sequenced per group, runts as group tails

IdxMap.note: dictionary RelativePath → placement; the cross-shard address table (gidx assigned here, after packing)

TotalPlannedSizeBytes.note: Σ shard PlannedSizeBytes = Σ rows + ShardCount × HeaderBytes

OversizedCount.note: shards with Class = Oversized (single record > ceiling; policy, not failure)

SingletonCount.note: single-record shards ≤ quota (full shards that happen to hold one record; not runts, not hazards)

TotalOvershootBytes.note: overshoot-facing: Σ over non-oversized shards of DeviationBytes clamped to max(0, ·) — clause 3 aggregate, harness column, NOT a bound

MaxOvershootBytes.note: tolerance-facing: max over non-oversized shards of DeviationBytes clamped to max(0, ·) — the exit-gate check, MaxOvershootBytes ≤ ShardToleranceBytes

TotalSlackBytes.note: Σ over non-oversized shards of max(0, −DeviationBytes) — the remainder, wherever the shape left it; mass-conservation check: TotalSlackBytes − TotalOvershootBytes == ShardCount×ShardQuotaBytes − Σ PlannedSizeBytes

MaxFillBytes.note: largest non-oversized shard's PlannedSizeBytes — what PackObjective=Even minimizes

HeaderOverheadBytes.note: ShardCount × HeaderBytes — the entire cost of shard count; what a worse k actually spends

HeaderBytes.note: echoed so the plan is self-describing

GroupKey.note: '.root' for root-level files under ByRootDirectory; extension key ('.noext' if none) under ByFileType; '' under Flat

Ordinal.note: 1-based, global across groups; final reading order

Key.note: sidx as filename fragment: 's{0:D3}' (+ '_<cleanGroup>' when grouped and not .root); width fixed before any name is written; NOT a row column

IsOversized.note: Class = Oversized; EntryCount = 1; PlannedSizeBytes > ceiling by policy; declared to the reader by manifest

PlannedSizeBytes.note: HeaderBytes + Σ Measure-Row over Entries — equals the written file's byte length exactly (exit gate; serialize asserts it)

DeviationBytes.note: SIGNED, anchored at quota: PlannedSizeBytes − ShardQuotaBytes. The stored fact; OvershootBytes/SlackBytes/Class all derive from it. < 0 underfilled (slack) · 0…tolerance overshoot, in band · > tolerance beyond ceiling, Oversized only

OvershootBytes.note: derived: max(0, DeviationBytes). 0 for Oversized (their excess is atomicity, not tolerance)

SlackBytes.note: derived: max(0, −DeviationBytes). Consistency: OvershootBytes − SlackBytes == DeviationBytes

Entries.note: references (indices) into assemble.out.result.Entries, in shard order (nominal sort restored within the shard)

GlobalIdx.note: 0..N−1, monotone in final reading order across all shards; the gidx column value (fixed width from layout.IdxWidth)
